hooks.text: In 1859, telegraphs sent messages while completely unplugged from their batteries.
One solar storm powered 19th-century communications using only the air itself.
Telegraph lines sent messages after their power sources were disconnected.

title: The Solar Storm That Powered the Telegraph
description: Discover how the Carrington Event of 1859 turned the sky into a battery and kept telegraph lines running without power.

beats.text: In 1859, telegraphs sent messages while completely unplugged from their batteries.
beats.visual: antique telegraph transmitter apparatus, photograph, late 19th century

beats.text: On September 1, astronomer Richard Carrington saw two blinding white flashes on the Sun.
beats.visual: Richard Carrington original sketch of 1859 sunspots, 1859

beats.text: Only 17.6 hours later, a massive cloud of solar plasma slammed into Earth.
beats.visual: NASA artist concept of CME impacting Earth's magnetosphere, 2010
queries: coronal mass ejection earth impact artist concept

beats.text: Auroras glowed so bright that miners in the Rockies woke up to cook breakfast.
beats.visual: Aurora borealis over a Rocky Mountain landscape, photograph

beats.text: Across the world, the magnetic storm induced high-voltage currents into the telegraph grid.
beats.visual: Earth magnetosphere interaction diagram, NASA Goddard, 2015

beats.text: Equipment sparked and set offices on fire as operators received electric shocks.
beats.visual: 19th century telegraph receiver machine, museum photograph

beats.text: Between Boston and Portland, operators realized they did not need their own batteries.
beats.visual: historical map of the Northeastern United States, 1850s

beats.text: They disconnected their equipment and successfully sent messages for about two hours using only the induced auroral current.
beats.visual: illustration of 19th century telegraph operators at work

beats.text: That is how a solar storm kept the telegraphs talking without any batteries.
beats.visual: Solar Dynamics Observatory extreme ultraviolet view of the Sun, 2012

better_than_last: Emphasized the specific historical detail of the Boston-Portland telegraph line to provide a fresh angle on the well-known Carrington Event.
